primary_ranking: paper-macro tokens per UTF8 byte, lower; token/formula additionally reported
comprehensive: weighted within-budget method percentile ranks, eligible only when every evaluated input roundtrips; report Pareto and weight sensitivity
timing: interleaved per-model order; full raw-string public encode including frontend; clear memoized/parser/BPE caches; no concurrent training or network tasks during final timing
confidence_interval: paired paper-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples; report seed spread separately
extreme_ood: entire source papers with target category, no such source category or domain in specialized fit/reward/dev
prior_models: retrained v6 controls, no old exposed weights
